title: LocalAI/defaults.json
description: The model to use for each kind of work. A value is the name of an installed model, "ask" (ask the person each time) or null (no choice; LocalAI picks an installed model itself). A key that is missing is the same as null. A tool uses a model the caller names first, then this default; with "ask", or a model that is no longer installed, it stops and the assistant asks the user.

chat.title: Chat
chat.description: The model a new chat starts with. When this key is missing, the older defaultModel of ui.json is used.

image.title: Image generation
image.description: The model that draws images (the generate_image tool).

tts.title: Text to speech
tts.description: The model that reads text aloud (the speak tool).

stt.title: Speech to text
stt.description: The model that turns speech into text (the transcribe_audio tool).

embeddings.title: Embeddings
embeddings.description: The model that turns text into vectors (the embed tool).

rerank.title: Reranking
rerank.description: The model that sorts search results by how well they match (the rerank tool).

video.title: Video generation
video.description: The model that makes short clips (the generate_video tool).

vision.title: Image understanding
vision.description: The model that looks at pictures and describes them (the describe_image tool).
